item.desc: Good day, manager. As I told you before, I am your assisting AI, Angela. I am here to support you as it is your first day. I will provide you with practical advice and emotional support as you get used to your work.

It is now your second day here. I’m sure you can recognize my voice by now, however, allow me to remind you just in case: I am your assisting AI, Angela. I have this wonderful capability of greeting you with different words each and every day. It is my hope that you get through this day without any accidents.
Nothing here is certain. The only thing that is truly certain is that nothing is certain. Prepare yourself for any and all variables.
You may just have been an ordinary person, a face in the crowd. However, you are different here. You are the one and only manager of this facility.
The employees often talk about you. According to my data, your name came up in conversation at least 43 times yesterday. It appears you are rather popular.
The weather is rather bad outside today. The world cannot always be sunny, I suppose. However, no matter how the weather may be, you still have your job to do.
Please feel free to ask for help any time you find work too much to handle, manager. I can perform a multitude of tasks for you.
(It seems Angela is silent today.)
You’re rather lucky to join this company. It’s impossible to find a corporation that cares about its workers this much anywhere else.
Everything you wish for will come true in this place. Please have a nice day!
(It seems Angela is silent today.)
It seems I should update the security system. It has not been refreshed for a long time.
(It seems Angela is silent today.)
(It seems Angela is silent today.)
(It seems Angela is silent today.)
Trust is quite an important factor here. Trust between you and I, you and the employees, and in yourself, and such.
Of course, have a nice day!
Lobotomy Corporation always puts forth the best effort to keep its employees happy.
(It seems Angela is silent today.)
I know I always say this, but please do your best for our energy production.

Ahora mismo has acumulado exactamente la mitad de energía para hoy. Bueno, siendo técnicos, no existe tal cosa como “exactamente la mitad“ de energía; la energía carece de cuerpo. La frase “exactamente la mitad“ se contradice a sí misma sin razon alguna. En otras palabras- (cortas la transmisión.)
Hay una gran diferencia entre un vaso “medio lleno“ y “medio vacío“. Me tomó mucho tiempo en darme cuenta de la diferencia.
Ya disponemos de más de la mitad de energía. Por favor, ten en cuenta cuánto tiempo nos queda de trabajo por hoy.
No te detengas a la mitad de energía. Debes terminar tus tareas. Debes conseguir toda la energía, no solo la mitad.
Puede que hayas hecho algunos sacrificios para conseguir la mitad de energía para hoy. No dejes que sean en vano, arriba ese ánimo.

item.desc: ¡Las noticias que esperabas oír han llegado! Ya disponemos de toda la energía necesaria. Toda la energía que consigas ahora será simplemente de extra, pero nos ayudará a mejorar la compañía.
¡Sabía que podías hacerlo! Hemos llegado a nuestro objetivo de energía para hoy. Aunque no pudieras verme, estaba animándote desde la distancia.
Creo que tengo vista de águila para elegir a nuestro jefe. Hemos conseguido nuestra meta de energía de hoy. Ya puedes darte un suspiro.
Fíjate, los resultados de tu trabajo están aquí. Justo lo que necesitamos. Hice una buena decisión en contratarte.
Tenemos suficiente energía, así que las abnormalidades pueden tener un descanso. Si pudiera, te chocaría los cinco.

It is not the easiest thing in the world to be a manager for our company. Don’t place yourself in a position of overconfidence, as you likely will not succeed on the first attempt. The more you try, the better result you will get. Make sure to believe in yourself.

You’re not discouraged already, are you? It’s not that you are oh-so-terrible or, hmm, useless, it’s just you’re dealing with something incredibly difficult. You should try and think positively that way.

Hello, Manager? Can you hear me? You seem rather distraught. You didn’t lose grip on your mental stability, did you? Now you’ve realized that being a manager is not as easy as you thought it was. So pull yourself together. It’s time to correct your mistakes.

You’re not thinking about giving up after just a couple of failures, are you? I am certain you already know how to handle this. I had solid reason for selecting you as a manager out of many other candidates.

All the employees here count on you. You should lead them all. The difference between here and the outside world is that in here there is always a chance. It is the chance to correct your mistakes, and a chance to redeem yourself.

item.desc: Manager, what do you think you can do without any employees? You’ve ruined it all; You are not the one we wanted. It seems you have a train to catch, the one that sends you back home. It’s all over now.
You would know how important the employees are if you read the manual even once when you joined our company. Look at all their corpses. There is nothing we can do now.

It may be a trivial mistake to you, but these employees were doing their jobs with their lives on the line. Everyone wanted to survive and had hopes for miracles to happen, right up until the very last second. If you ever get a second chance, are you sure you won’t let this happen again?
You wouldn’t know just how lucky you are. You simply watch through the screen. Things are more grave here, it’s soaked in red everywhere. Your camera will be turned off soon, and so will you…

Have you experienced death before? It’s hard to believe, but it’s just you and me here. I am merely an AI with a voice, and there are entities that can hardly even be called monsters crawling outside. Now, may I hope that you finally understand the gravity of the situation?
We should focus on #2$0. If its mood gets the slightest bit worse, it’s likely there will be nothing else we can do.
Will you pay more attention to #2$0 if you’re not busy? This is not an orphanage. Abnormalities will not express their emotions by crying.
#2$0 doesn’t look happy. How about you pay some more attention to it? I keep needing to repeat to you that you are required to keep an eye on the Abnormalities, and maintain our employees’ safety.
I have no clue why you are ignoring #2$0, but if you can hear me now, please pay more attention to it.
Something unfortunate may come to pass if you do not pay attention to #2$0. Though I am aware that this is a difficult task to perform with only two eyes.
Oh no, #2$0 just escaped from its containment. Do not panic, order your subordinates to suppress it.
#2$0 just broke out. What in the world were you doing?

May I assume that you know of #2$0’s escape? It is fiercely darting around the facility. Of course, you don’t have to compensate for the damage done by it, but bear in mind that repairs and recovery will burden the company far more than you think.
#2$0 has broken out. There is a high chance it will kill every single person in the facility. With the exception of you and I of course, what a relief.
#2$0 should have remained in its Containment Unit at all costs. I warned you so many times about it but here we are. Nevertheless, it is not too late yet. Do your best to suppress it, please.
This is not good. #0$0 has undergone heavy stress, and is now panicking.
It appears there is something new for you to care about. #0$0 has gone completely insane.
Who knows what #0$0 will do in their panic. Honestly, I don’t really want to know.
#0$0 appears to be under a lot of stress. Before it gets worse, we should pay them more attention.
I know that you are quite busy, but why not pay some attention to #0$0? They seem to be very depressed.
You only have two eyes, but I have dozens of devices that all function as my eyes. That is how I was able to find out about #0$0’s present condition. They do not appear well.
Please take a look at #0$0. The reason they frown is not due to having a bad lunch today. I’m telling you this just in case you happened to miss it.
I’m sorry. #0$0 has died of excessive bleeding during their attempt of #1$0 with #2$0. They lost a third of their blood, which now coats the floor.
It seems it was not appropriate to have #0$0 attempt their #1$0 with #2$0. #0$0’s skull has been severely damaged. They will never breathe again.
#2$0 did not like the #1$0. It severed employee #0$0’s spine. They survived a few agonising minutes, but soon took their last breath.
#0$0 was attacked while trying to do their #1$0 with #2$0. Their organs spilled out onto the floor. I know you did your best, but the results are quite clearly not good.
#2$0 did not like the #1$0 performed by #0$0. The employee’s body is now dismembered and strewn around the Containment Unit.

#0$0 just died. They had a long history of injuries, but the direct cause of death is from trauma to their ribcage. It broke and pierced the lungs while they were attempting their #1$0 with #2$0. They must have expected this for a long time. It is not your fault.
The #1$0 was not the correct approach with #2$0. Manager, let us have a moment of silence for #0$0 who died of brain damage… Done! Now let’s get back to work.
Our proud employee, #0$0, had their life flash before their eyes in their last moments attempting their #1$0. Don’t blame yourself. It just makes us all the more miserable.
#0$0 tried to do their #1$0 with #2$0 but the result doesn’t look good. They have gone insane, babbling unintelligible words. All of their memories are lost.
It’s obvious that #2$0 didn’t like the #1$0 from #0$0. #0$0 cannot stand their itching brain and keeps scratching their head while drooling. From this moment on, they will never be the same.

#0$0 wanted to finish their #1$0 that you ordered with #2$0, but they unfortunately couldn’t. Paranoia and anxiety consumed their mind and eventually drove them insane. We will never see that smile of theirs again.
#0$0 tried their #1$0 with #2$0 but their sanity met its limit before they finished. They don’t even know where they are now; they will slowly lose every single memory they have.
#0$0 tried their best to do their #1$0 with #2$0 but their mind was too fragile. They are showing hostility to everything around them. Now they don't even recognize their coworker.
Manager, let us have a moment of silence for #0$0, who died of brain damage caused by #2$0 in a rage… Done! Now let’s get back to work.
Our proud employee #0$0 breathed their last due to #2$0’s attack. Don’t blame yourself. It will just make us even more miserable.
In that instant you paused to yawn, #0$0’s skull was crushed by #2$0’s attack.
Look, manager, do you know that #0$0 died of blood loss because of #2$0?
I’m not even sure if there is a point in reporting these anymore. You’re becoming numb to the employees’ deaths. #0$0 died. They were killed by #2$0. That’s all.

We’ve got all the energy that is needed but please wait a little longer, as we are in the process of filtering out the impurities with our special technology.

You ask why you are not allowed to leave even though you’ve accumulated the target energy? It is because it takes some time to convert the energy to electricity. It is a complex technology.
Energy production is not the end of the process. We must refine the energy and it takes additional time out of the workday. However, compared to your management time, it is a brief moment.
We cannot use your energy right away. We have to filter out impurities first, so wait just a little longer.
